plugins.name: assets
plugins.description: Provides configuration, metadata, session-discovery, and dataset skills for sollertia-shared-assets, the asset backbone of the Sollertia platform. Includes MCP bindings for asset authoring and validation, project and session discovery, dataset inspection, and the Unity Editor relay, plus a reference for the human-facing slsa command-line interface.

plugins.name: unity
plugins.description: Provides Unity Editor integration skills for sollertia-virtual-reality, generating VR tasks from templates and managing scenes, prefabs, and Play Mode. Includes MCP bindings, through the assets plugin's sollertia-shared-assets server, for the Unity Editor relay this project's McpBridge exposes.

plugins.name: experiment
plugins.description: Provides acquisition-system design, hardware interface, runtime, and library-extension skills for sollertia-experiment and sollertia-micro-controllers, the system-agnostic core a companion plugin such as mesoscope extends. Includes MCP bindings for hardware discovery, system configuration, and session management, plus a reference for the human-facing sle command-line interface.

plugins.name: mesoscope
plugins.description: Provides the Mesoscope-VR reference acquisition system skills, the worked example an agent copies for a new system, covering its runtime, its record schemas, and its processing donations to sollertia-forgery. Includes a reference for the human-facing sle mesoscope command group, and requires the assets, experiment, and forging plugins.

plugins.name: forging
plugins.description: Provides data processing, job planning, dataset forging, and remote-execution skills for sollertia-forgery, which turns recorded sessions into per-session tables and multi-session datasets. Includes MCP bindings for batch processing, planning, dataset composition, and SLURM submission, plus a reference for the human-facing slf command-line interface.
